option.name: --aligned
tip: Use with --separator to align the output columns

option.name: --all
tip: List all VGs.

option.name: --binary
tip: Use binary values "0" or "1" instead of descriptive literal values for columns that have exactly two valid values to report (not counting the "unknown" value which denotes that the value could not be determined).

option.name: --commandprofile
tip: The command profile to use for command configuration.

option.name: --config
tip: Config settings for the command.

option.name: --configreport
tip: See lvmreport(7).

option.name: --debug
tip: Set debug level.

option.name: --devices
tip: Restricts the devices that are visible and accessible to the command.

option.name: --devicesfile
tip: A file listing devices that LVM should use.

option.name: --driverloaded
tip: If set to no, the command will not attempt to use device-mapper.

option.name: --foreign
tip: Report/display foreign VGs that would otherwise be skipped.

option.name: --headings
tip: Type of headings to use in report output.

option.name: --help
tip: Display help text.

option.name: --ignorelockingfailure
tip: Allows a command to continue with read-only metadata operations after locking failures.

option.name: --journal
tip: Record information in the systemd journal.

option.name: --lockopt
tip: Used to pass options for special cases to lvmlockd.

option.name: --logonly
tip: Suppress command report and display only log report.

option.name: --longhelp
tip: Display long help text.

option.name: --nameprefixes
tip: Add an "LVM2_" prefix plus the field name to the output.

option.name: --noheadings
tip: Suppress the headings line that is normally the first line of output.

option.name: --nohints
tip: Do not use the hints file to locate devices for PVs.

option.name: --nolocking
tip: Disable locking.

option.name: --nosuffix
tip: Suppress the suffix on output sizes.

option.name: --options
tip: Comma-separated, ordered list of fields to display in columns.

option.name: --profile
tip: An alias for --commandprofile or --metadataprofile, depending on the command.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress output and log messages.

option.name: --readonly
tip: Prevent the command from making changes, including activation and metadata updates.

option.name: --reportformat
tip: Overrides current output format for reports which is defined globally by the report/output_format setting in lvm.conf(5).

option.name: --rows
tip: Output columns as rows.

option.name: --select
tip: Select objects for processing and reporting based on specified criteria.

option.name: --separator
tip: String to use to separate each column.

option.name: --shared
tip: Report/display shared VGs that would otherwise be skipped when lvmlockd is not being used on the host.

option.name: --sort
tip: Comma-separated ordered list of columns to sort by.

option.name: --test
tip: Run in test mode.

option.name: --unbuffered
tip: Produce output immediately without sorting or aligning the columns properly.

option.name: --units
tip: All sizes are output in these units: human-(r)eadable with '<' rounding indicator, (h)uman-readable, (b)ytes, (s)ectors, (k)ilobytes, (m)egabytes, (g)igabytes, (t)erabytes, (p)etabytes, (e)xabytes.

option.name: --unquoted
tip: When used with --nameprefixes, output values in the field=value pairs are not quoted.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Set verbose level.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: --yes
tip: Do not prompt for confirmation interactively but always assume the answer yes.
